description: As I travel around South Dakota, I continue to hear from South Dakotans struggling to pay for healthcare and worrying about affording the medicine they need. Meanwhile, the Trump Administration and Congress continue to take us in the wrong direction – driving up the cost of health care and increasing the number of uninsured Americans. We need a Congress that will stop these disastrous cuts.Last week, the Trump Administration announced plans to end subsidies that limit premium increases for Medic
title: Affordability is the KEY word I'm hearing!
